name: M7.GeneratedFamily.family_injective
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < w → w ≤ N → M7.PrefixSector.ValidSector N E → Function.Injective (M7.GeneratedFamily.family N w E)
guidance:
Original M7 structural family is the ACTUAL compact generator emission list indexed by Fin length, not a supplied transversal. Preserve original 0<w≤N and ValidSector. family_range uses CompactGeneration.run_fold specialized to generate, list get membership and fold insert. family_good comes from CompactCorrectness.generate_exact GoodBases on finalBases. family_anchored uses positive equal cards, canonical_anchored and family_good normalization. family_injective uses generate_exact mapped-list Nodup and injective list get. family_separated follows canonical_invariant for equal actual placements, normalized bases and injectivity. family_meets uses CompactCorrectness.run_leaves specialized to the concrete initial run; CompactCorrectness.run_records gives every stored emission actual action/inverse and literal signature fields, hence its actual queried leaf, whose root membership has signature in E. Do not require the canonical signature itself to belong to E. For family_complete forward use actual ClassValid action preservation and transport the sector witness back along the inverse record. Reverse first transport c to a queried image, use final zero/remaining empty and RawCoverage.remaining_coverage, then family_range and actual compose/inverse to realize c. This proves precisely the classes whose orbit meets E, including canonical signatures outside E. Global query/root replay and resources remain downstream. Return tactic lines only.
import M7CompactCorrectnessAccepted
import M7RawCoverageAccepted
import M7GlobalQueryAccepted

namespace M7.GeneratedFamily
noncomputable def size (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) : ℕ :=
  (M7.CompactGeneration.generate (N := N) w E).emitted.length
noncomputable def family (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) :
    M7.GlobalQuery.Family (size N w E) N :=
  fun i => ((M7.CompactGeneration.generate (N := N) w E).emitted.get i).representative
end M7.GeneratedFamily
